title: 第259章 假惺惺第255章 族老傻眼还要女人
slug: 玄幻苟在深山打猎开局弟妹上门求肉
lines: 地上，王渊还在痛苦的抽搐哀嚎着。
而王大山静静的站在血泊边缘，听着面前这个所谓亲生母亲大言不惭的瞎扯。
王大山不仅没有生气，反而是忍不住的直接放声大笑了起来。
他慢慢的收起了笑容，眼神就像是在看一个跳梁小丑一般。
王大山上前一步，压迫感十足的盯着李清玉。
“你口中所谓的怕我过不了好生活，怕我适应不了侯府。”
“所以你们就心安理得的，让我在穷乡僻壤里受折磨？”
王大山嘴角勾起一抹冷笑，眼中满是讥讽与不屑。
“李清玉，你们真的是我的亲生父母吗？”
“这种连狗听了都嫌荒谬的借口，你怎么能够说的出如此可笑的话？”
李清玉听到王大山毫不留情的质问，下意识的避开了王大山的目光，不敢去直视他的眼睛。
“这小畜生怎么这么牙尖嘴利！”
李清玉在心里暗自发虚。
“当年没把他接回来，本来就是不想让他碍眼，现在竟然被他当面给戳穿了！”
可是。
当着这么多下人的面，她堂堂侯府主母的面子绝对不能丢。
更何况，她还要护着自己最心疼的小儿子王渊。
李清玉咬紧了牙关，硬着头皮，决定继续胡扯下去。
“你……你笑什么！”
李清玉梗着脖子，强行摆出一副长辈的威严。
她伸手指着王大山，眼神里毫不掩饰的流露出一丝鄙夷。
“难道我说错了吗？”
“你看你现在的这副样子！”
李清玉嫌恶的上下打量了一番王大山。
“你从那个穷乡僻野出来，粗鄙不堪，浑身都是改不掉的穷人病！”
“你哪里有半点侯府少爷的规矩和体面？”
李清玉转过头，心疼的看了一眼地上惨叫的王渊。
“你再看看渊儿！”
“渊儿从小就在这里生活着，受的是最好的教养，知书达理。”
“如果当年直接把你找回来了。”
“你不仅会因为规矩不懂而在京城闹笑话，不仅对你不好。”
“对渊儿的成长，也会造成巨大的打击，对他也不好啊！”
“我这么做，全都是为了保全你们两兄弟啊！”
听着这番堪称三观炸裂的奇葩言论。
content_en:
On the ground, Wang Yuan was still twitching in pain and wailing.
And Wang Dashan stood quietly on the edge of the pool of blood, listening to the shameless nonsense of the so-called biological mother in front of him.
Not only was Wang Dashan not angry, he couldn't help but burst out laughing.
He slowly put away his smile, his eyes were like looking at a clown.
Wang Dashan took a step forward and stared at Li Qingyu with a sense of oppression.
"You said you were afraid that I wouldn't be able to live a good life, that I wouldn't be able to adapt to the Hou Mansion."
"So you can just feel at ease and let me suffer in a remote village?"
A sneer curled up at the corner of Wang Dashan's mouth, his eyes full of sarcasm and disdain.
"Li Qingyu, are you really my biological parents?"
"This is an excuse that even a dog would find ridiculous. How could you say such ridiculous things?"
When Li Qingyu heard Wang Dashan's merciless questioning, she subconsciously avoided Wang Dashan's gaze and did not dare to look directly into his eyes.
"Why is this little beast so sharp-tongued!"
Li Qingyu felt guilty secretly in her heart.
"I didn't take him back back then because I didn't want him to be an eyesore, but now I've been exposed by him in person!"
But.
In front of so many servants, she must not lose face as the majestic mistress of the Hou Mansion.
What's more, she still has to protect her most beloved son, Wang Yuan.
Li Qingyu gritted his teeth, gritted his teeth, and decided to continue talking nonsense.
"You...why are you laughing!"
Li Qingyu stiffened her neck and forced herself to look majestic as an elder.
She pointed at Wang Dashan with her hand, a trace of disdain undisguised in her eyes.
"Did I say something wrong?"
"Look at what you look like now!"
Li Qingyu looked Wang Dashan up and down in disgust.
"You came out of that poor and remote country, you are so vulgar, and you are covered with the diseases of the poor that cannot be cured!"
"How do you have any of the rules and decency of a young master from the Hou Mansion?"
Li Qingyu turned her head and glanced distressedly at Wang Yuan who was screaming on the ground.
"Look at Yuan'er again!"
"Yuan'er has lived here since he was a child. He received the best education and is well-educated."
"If I could just find you back then."
"Not only will you make a joke in the capital because you don't understand the rules, it's not only bad for you."
"It will also have a huge impact on Yuan'er's growth, and it won't be good for him either!"
"I did this all to protect you two brothers!"
Listening to these bizarre remarks, it can be said that one’s world view is shattered.
title_en: Chapter 259 Hypocrisy Chapter 255 The clan leader is dumbfounded and wants a woman
